name: Yorg.io 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Yorg.io 3 is a unique multiplayer tower defense game set during a zombie apocalypse. This is the third installment of the popular series, Yorg.io. Yorg.io 3 takes a simplistic approach with its animation with a top-view playing field. The zombies only attack at night so take the day to load up on supplies while building both your defensive towers. You can kill zombies with cannons or arrows or use walls to make it difficult for them to get to your home base. On top of killing zombies, you need supplies like crystals, stones, and lumbar to create towers. Use your upgrade options to enhance your current towers making them more efficient. You also have the option to play solo or join a multiplayer session where you can compete against other players during a live session. As you gain coins, you can unlock other cool playing fields and levels. Join in and see what all the fuss is about in this tower defense IO game.
